title: CLAUDE.md
text: ggpyramid R package extends ggplot2 building population pyramids (back--back bar charts population age group sex). Matan Hakim’s personal open-source package, public GitHub matanhakim/ggpyramid, pkgdown site https://matanhakim.github.io/ggpyramid/. Sibling packages author live next (../il.cbs.muni, ../rtlr) set house conventions DESCRIPTION, pkgdown CI; match . Status (Oct 2026): version 0.1.0, prepared first CRAN submission (cran-comments.md) yet submitted. Exports: geom_pyramid()/stat_pyramid(), geom_pyramid_text(), geom_pyramid_outline(), position_pyramid(), coord_pyramid(), scale_x_pyramid()/scale_y_pyramid(), theme_pyramid() europe_pop data (built data-raw/europe_pop.R Eurostat). Design research, architecture alternatives agreed API live dev/design-research.md (Hebrew); section 8 records Matan’s decisions, nothing implemented ahead . Throwaway prototypes dev/spikes/; dev/ build-ignored. Architecture: PositionPyramid (inherits PositionStack) owns correctness. negates value axis left side, stacks within side, geom can take position = "pyramid". side comes side aesthetic (declared Position’s default_aes), else fill, else colour. StatPyramid counts rows sums mapped value writes counts , denominator, proportions straight value axis; constructors attach child stat whose default_aes names axis. Orientation defaults horizontal (age y) axes continuous. CoordPyramid (inherits CoordCartesian, horizontal ) owns look: wraps x view scale absolute labels, makes limits symmetric, moves age scale modify_scales(), opens centre gap transform(), axis keys grid lines also pass . zero belongs side row; lone zero left negative zero written Position. Build negative zeros -abs(x): byte compiler folds literal -0 0. Absolute labels go magnitude() (rounded 12 significant digits) float noise label two sides differently. GeomPyramidText GeomPyramidOutline prepare data delegate drawing GeomText GeomPath.

title: Mirror one side of a population pyramid — position_pyramid
code: library(ggplot2)  pop <- data.frame(   age = factor(rep(c("0-19", "20-39", "40-59", "60+"), 2)),   sex = factor(rep(c("Male", "Female"), each = 4), c("Male", "Female")),   n = c(220, 200, 160, 90, 210, 205, 170, 120) )  # Any geom can be mirrored ggplot(pop, aes(x = n, y = age, fill = sex)) +   geom_col(position = position_pyramid()) +   geom_text(aes(label = n, hjust = -0.2), position = "pyramid") +   scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)) +   coord_pyramid()   # Subgroups stack within each side pop2 <- rbind(transform(pop, group = "A"), transform(pop, group = "B")) ggplot(pop2, aes(x = n, y = age, fill = group, side = sex)) +   geom_col(position = position_pyramid(left = "Female"))

title: ggpyramid 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. coord_pyramid() coordinate system horizontal pyramids. labels value axis without minus sign left side, makes symmetric around zero, places age axis left, right, sides gap centre. europe_pop holds population France, Ireland, Italy Poland 2004 2024 age group sex, Eurostat, examples. geom_pyramid() stat_pyramid() draw bars population pyramid. count individual records sum mapped value, denominator shows bars proportions panel side. geom_pyramid_outline() draws pyramid stepped outline, compare second population bars. geom_pyramid_text() labels end bar, outside inside , sides. position_pyramid() mirrors one side pyramid stacks subgroups within side, layer. side comes new side aesthetic, fill side mapped. scale_x_pyramid() scale_y_pyramid() label value axis absolute values make symmetric, vertical pyramids coordinate systems. theme_pyramid() minimal theme pyramids, legend top.
